title: $\mathbb{P}^1$ Homotopy Theory of Schemes
summary: We study the $\mathbb{P}^1$-local motivic homotopy theory under the Nisnevich topology on $Sm_S$. We show that although the homotopy category $\mathcal{H}^{\mathbb{P}^1}(-)$ admits standard schematic functorialities, it fails six-functor gluing, thereby obstructing a full six-functor formalism. On the unstable side, we prove that the unstable $\mathbb{P}^1$-motivic localization preserves Nisnevich connectivity, despite the absence of an interval structure on $\mathbb{P}^1$.
